report_discrepancies.note: Street Fund budgetary comparison schedule: printed Total expenditures (Actual) 8,429,946, but the printed actual lines add to 8,368,066 (each line's printed variance agrees with its budget and actual; budget column 9,281,925 and variance column 851,979 tie to the printed totals). Lines recorded as printed.

notes: GAAP (modified accrual funds). Governmental lines from the Total column of the governmental funds statement (p5); ending_cash = governmental funds Balance Sheet cash and cash equivalents 8,215,929 (p4); ending_investments = restricted Certificates of Deposit 254,783 printed on the same balance sheet (restricted cash 3,761,866 shown separately); beginning cash not printed. Taxes 8,907,618 split: Sales Tax Fund 4,581,795 (= Statement of Activities sales tax), Hotel/Motel Tax Fund 80,405 (lodging, fund name), TIF funds 301,920 (property tax increment, fund name); remaining 3,943,498 (General sub-fund, Debt Service, Street) stays unlabeled because the Statement of Activities breakdown does not tie. Bond proceeds 5,726,322 = debt_proceeds; sale of assets 414,457 + insurance proceeds 9,717 = other_financing. p5 General Fund column reports Library 638,105 and principal 98,725 where the p16 combining statement shows Library 736,830 (same total 5,562,133). Business-type: Water + Sewer from p7 (operating + nonoperating; interest expense and bonding costs as debt service interest); operating 'Other' 5,356,423 is shown as general revenue 'Other income' on the Statement of Activities (not charges for services). Proprietary cash flows from p8. Detail: General Fund budget schedules (revenues p12, expenditures/other financing p10; chosen over the General Fund combining statement p16 to avoid double counting), Street Fund budget (pp13-14; warrant income printed among revenues; actual lines do not add to the printed total, see report_discrepancies), Keno Fund budget (p15), TIF funds combining statement (p17, 5 funds). Zero-actual budget lines (General special assessments, federal grants, Reuse, insurance proceeds) not recorded. Debt Service Fund and proprietary funds have no supplementary schedule. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (pp1-2), per column. Read pages 1-17 of 17
